description:
Outcome: Coordinator reviews applications, allocates, waitlists and sees holders in a grid, from brief.md: First version must 2 and 5
Scope: Priority indicators/filters; valid allocation actions; bulk move unallocated applicants to ordered queue; offer/accept/decline controls; accessible map/list alternative; audit view. Excludes: Contacts on gardener screens
Acceptance: Grid always shows all 40 plots with vacancy or holder; server-side role checks; promotion follows allocation rules; only coordinator can see contact data
Behaviour: Readable mobile map/list; no-application/loading/error states; refresh concurrent changes
Verification: API/role/UI tests plus 41 or more competing applications across 40 plots. Prerequisites: T-003, T-006, T-007, T-004. Assumptions: Coordinator contacts gardener and records acceptance or decline
title: Coordinator allocation workspace and 40-plot map
